snippet.title: Supersonic Fight - In-game Footage - Trailer May 2025
snippet.description:
💥 Supersonic Fight 💥

Wishlist on Steam 🛩️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716570

Get ready to take to the skies in Supersonic Fight — a modern tribute to classic jet combat games like F/A-18 Interceptor, reimagined for today’s players. Set against the backdrop of San Francisco, this Combat Flight Simulator blends thrilling dogfights, high-speed intercepts, and unexpected missions.

👨‍✈️ Features:

• Fly advanced fighter jets in visually stunning, real-world environments

• Experience a cinematic single-player campaign 

• Customize your aircraft and helmet to make your pilot truly yours

• A spiritual successor to the legendary F/A-18 Interceptor — with modern gameplay and classic heart

• Made with love by a solo developer passionate about flight sims, arcade action, and storytelling.

Wishlist on Steam 🛩️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716570

👉 Follow development updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes:
🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/2AQMA9Wvgd

Subscribe for more dev updates and trailers!

#SupersonicFight #IndieGame #FlightSimulator #JetFighter #UnityGame #F18Interceptor #AirCombat #MadeInUnity #IndieDev
